purpose: Deterministically reproduce OpenWorker's no-tool completion boundary and test whether its existing queue_steering primitive can continue a bounded turn only when an objective validator remains failing.
changed_capability: event-consumer queues steering after an assistant message with no tool calls only when the objective validator state is failing

cases.question: Does current TurnEngine complete after a failing verifier is followed by ordinary assistant prose with no tool call?
Can queue_steering continue that same turn when the validator is still failing?
Does the same objective steering recover when the no-tool turn is marked finish_reason=length?
Does the guard avoid forcing another iteration after a passing verifier?

acceptance: all four deterministic cases match their expected event/call behavior
the steering cases consume the built-in queue_steering mechanism without modifying OpenWorker source
the passing-verifier control proves the guard does not continue completed work merely because the last assistant message has no tool call
